pages.title: Cave Hyena
pages.text: The cave hyena ($(o)Crocuta crocuta spelaea$()) is an extinct form of the spotted hyena that lived across Europe and northern Asia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was larger than the living spotted hyena, and both hunted and scavenged large Ice Age animals such as horses and woolly rhinoceroses.$(br2)Cave hyenas used caves as dens, where they gathered huge accumulations of gnawed bones.
